name: Rippled Glass
description: A pane of rippled glass over the scene behind the window. The blurred backdrop warps across the whole pane under a drifting watery distortion, with slight colour fringing and soft highlights along the ripples. It shows through wherever the window itself is translucent, and the Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the ripples.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Blur radius
parameters.description: How strongly the scene behind the glass is blurred (px)

parameters.name: Corner radius
parameters.description: Corner rounding of the glass pane (px, match the Border pack)

parameters.name: Content opacity
parameters.description: How visible the window content stays over the pane, where 1.0 is fully opaque and 0.0 shows only the rippled backdrop

parameters.name: Ripple strength
parameters.description: How far the ripples bend the backdrop (px)

parameters.name: Ripple drift
parameters.description: How quickly the ripples drift, where 0 freezes them

parameters.name: Colour fringing
parameters.description: Chromatic split between the red and blue refraction

parameters.name: Ripple highlights
parameters.description: Strength of the light caught along the ripple crests

parameters.name: Tint strength
parameters.description: How much of the tint colour is mixed over the glass

parameters.name: Round bottom corners
parameters.description: Round the bottom corners as well as the top. Turn off to round only the top two

parameters.name: Edge softness
parameters.description: Anti-alias feather of the pane edge, in device pixels, so it does not grow with display scaling. Lower is crisper

parameters.name: Brightness
parameters.description: Gain on the blurred scene. 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Contrast
parameters.description: Contrast of the blurred scene around mid grey. 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Saturation
parameters.description: Colour saturation of the blurred scene. 0 is greyscale and 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Noise
parameters.description: Fine grain over the blur that hides banding in smooth gradients

parameters.name: Vibrancy
parameters.description: Boosts saturation where a colour is already saturated and bright, so muted scenes stay muted. 0 turns it off, and Vibrancy darkness widens it to darker colours

parameters.name: Vibrancy darkness
parameters.description: How far the vibrancy boost reaches into darker colours. Does nothing while Vibrancy is 0, which is where it starts

parameters.name: Mirror at the edge
parameters.description: Where the bend reaches past the pane's edge, fold the backdrop back inside instead of stretching the edge pixel
